# ArtScript

> A web language and framework designed so that AI models build and change full-stack web apps with fewer tokens, retries and dollars than React, Svelte or Vue. `.art` files compile to small, dependency-free JavaScript (signals, direct DOM) plus a Node server (REST apis from models, SQLite, auth). This website is itself an ArtScript app.

Read the spec before writing code; read the edit spec when only changing existing code.

## Docs

- [Spec](https://artscript.dev/md/SPEC.md): the whole language in ~3K tokens (declarations, members, backend, view, tests, rules).
- [Edit spec](https://artscript.dev/md/SPEC-EDIT.md): ~800 tokens, enough to change existing code.
- [Working with AI agents](https://artscript.dev/md/agents.md): MCP, the instructions file and the build-check-patch loop.
- [Quick start](https://artscript.dev/md/quick-start.md): create, run and build an app.
- [Tutorial](https://artscript.dev/md/tutorial.md): a full-stack app step by step.
- [CLI](https://artscript.dev/md/cli.md): every `art` command.
- [Deploying](https://artscript.dev/md/DEPLOY.md): static hosts, Node, Docker, Fly.io, Railway, Render.
- [Security](https://artscript.dev/md/SECURITY.md): what apps get by default.

## Tools for agents

- `art mcp`: an MCP server with `art_spec`, `art_check`, `art_context` and `art_patch`.
- `art check --ai`: errors as JSON with `expected`, `actual` and `fixes`.
- `art context [Name...]`: compact context and every addressable patch path.
- `art patch`: structured, atomic, type-checked edits instead of rewriting files.
